title: Does Olive Oil Go Bad? How to Tell If Expired Oil Is Rancid Or Just Old
seoTitle: Does Olive Oil Go Bad? How Long It Lasts and How to Tell
excerpt: Olive oil does not spoil like milk. It goes past its best within about a year, losing around 42% of its polyphenols, and turns rancid much later. How long each stage takes and how to tell them apart.
seoDescription: Olive oil goes past its best long before it goes bad. How long it lasts opened and unopened, how to spot rancid oil, and why the harvest date matters.
